record_title: Tensor amplification of the strong maximal A2 obstruction
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The lower bound is asymptotic and is not claimed sharp. It does not improve the infimum of admissible pure-power exponents, nor establish a matching linear-times-log upper bound. The two-dimensional input is Lerner's recent preprint. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with the main residual risk coming from contemporaneous or not-yet-indexed discussion of the September 2026 source preprints. No independent validation is asserted.
